{{Quote|If you are here to help I'm glad to see you. If not you are in the wrong place.|Lieutenant Varias, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtLV" />}}
'''Varias''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|This cave here seems to contain an old droid factory from the Clone Wars. For some reason it's been reactivated. If you are willing to help, go into the cave and talk to Lieutenant Varias. He'll be in the Corsec command post.|[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Jornel Savas|Savas]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtLV" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Varias held the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] and was based in the city of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TtLV" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the CorSec received reports of hostile [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] active in the [[Bindreg Hills]]. A group led by Lieutenant Varias, including [[Officer/Legends|Officers]] [[Jornel Savas|Savas]], [[Hirka]], [[Druno Kener|Kener]], [[Mener]] and several CorSec troopers, was dispatched from Coronet to investigate. The unit discovered an old and fully automated [[Corellia Droid Factory|droid factory]], presumably built in secret by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the Clone Wars.<ref name="SWG:TtLV" /> The CorSec ignored that the factory had been reactivated by [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]] for his project of [[Droid Revolution]].<ref name="SWG:DtDF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disable the Droid Factory|Corellia}}</ref> The droid factory was defended by many battle droids but the Corellian government was reluctant to send reinforcement since it would like to avoid drawing the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:TtLV" />

[[File:Corellia_Droid_Factory_1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Corellia Droid Factory]].]]
Lieutenant Varias assigned missions to all his officers with the objective to disable the droid factory.<ref name="SWG:TtLV" /> [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] Savas was tasked to recruit independent spacers to assist the CorSec in the factory,<ref name="SWG:CtCA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Contact the Corsec Agent|Corellia}}</ref> [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Hirka was ordered to recon the factory,<ref name="SWG:LtLCP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Locate the Lost Corsec Patrol" on Corellia</ref> [[technical officer]] Kener had to find a way to shut down the facility,<ref name="SWG:FaAtFCT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Find and Activate the Four Control Terminals" on Corellia</ref> and Sergeant Mener was tasked to take the fight to the droids.<ref name="SWG:D10BD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Destroy 10 Battle Droids|Corellia}}</ref> When Sergeant Hirka and her squad went missing, Lieutenant Varias dispatched a spacer to rescue her.<ref name="SWG:LtLCP" /> The spacer then worked with Officer Kener to create a security breach in the factory's control system.<ref name="SWG:FaAtFCT" /> Eventually, Varias tasked the spacer to access the control override terminal in the depths of the facility. The spacer finally reached the terminal in the command center and effectively shut down the factory. According to Lieutenant Varias, the intervention of the spacers permitted to contain the crisis and avoid a disaster.<ref name="SWG:DtDF" />

Varias later asked a spacer to assist an associate, [[Wernell Covington]], on the moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="SWG:DtDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Varias was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtLV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lieutenant Varias was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Corellia Droid Factory|Corellian Droid Factory]]" arc with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
